name: mobile-repair-os
description: Mobile Repair OS Egypt - منصة إدارة وتشغيل مراكز صيانة الموبايل (Express + MongoDB + Next.js)

scripts.dev: npm run build:api && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:watch: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:watch --workspace @mros/api" "npm run dev --workspace @mros/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @mros/api && npm run build --workspace @mros/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run start --workspace @mros/api" "npm run start --workspace @mros/web"
scripts.seed: npm run build:api && npm run seed --workspace @mros/api
scripts.seed:reset: npm run build:api && npm run seed:reset --workspace @mros/api
scripts.bootstrap:platform: npm run build:api && npm run bootstrap:platform --workspace @mros/api
scripts.fix:indexes: npm run build:api && npm run fix:indexes --workspace @mros/api
scripts.fix:indexes:dry: npm run build:api && npm run fix:indexes:dry --workspace @mros/api
scripts.fix:counters: npm run build:api && npm run fix:counters --workspace @mros/api
scripts.fix:counters:dry: npm run build:api && npm run fix:counters:dry --workspace @mros/api
scripts.audit:finance: npm run build:api && npm run audit:finance --workspace @mros/api
